creator: Alexander Terp
description:
herdr refuses any client frame over 2 MiB (`MAX_FRAME_SIZE`) and skips it with a WARN, so an attached client receives nothing for that render pass and the pane freezes (`a_2KHGYMpnK`).

herdr already degrades oversized *graphics* frames - "dropping graphics from oversized frame". Text has no fallback, though a text frame that will not fit could be sent as a partial or a damaged region rather than dropped whole.

Muster's side is now a ceiling that stops a pane reaching that size (`a_2KHGYMpnK`), which is prevention rather than a fix. The daemon dropping a frame and telling nobody is herdr's to answer.
title: ⬆️ Upstream herdr: a text frame over the cap could degrade rather than be skipped
